scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,BOT,WEB -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:bot" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.build:api: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/database && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/ai-engine && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/api
scripts.build:bot: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/database && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/ai-engine && npm run build --workspace=@nexworth/bot
